description: This file defines the class XTemplate, a PHP class used for HTML template rendering and processing, including block parsing, variable assignment, and template output.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: A PHP class for handling HTML templates with block parsing, variable substitution, and file inclusion features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the template by loading from a file.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends values to a variable in the template.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a specified template block, processing variables and sub-blocks.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a block has been parsed or exists.

methods.name: var_exists
methods.description: Checks if a variable exists within a block.

methods.name: rparse
methods.description: Recursively parses a block and its sub-blocks.

methods.name: insert_loop
methods.description: Inserts a loop by assigning a variable and parsing a block.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the parsed text for a block.

methods.name: out
methods.description: Outputs the parsed block, with access control considerations.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parsed content of a block.

methods.name: parsed
methods.description: Checks if a block was parsed.

methods.name: SetNullString
methods.description: Sets the replacement string for undefined variables.

methods.name: SetNullBlock
methods.description: Sets the replacement string for undefined blocks.

methods.name: set_autoreset
methods.description: Enables auto-reset of sub-blocks after parsing.

methods.name: clear_autoreset
methods.description: Disables auto-reset of sub-blocks after parsing.

methods.name: scan_globals
methods.description: Scans global variables and assigns them to the template.

methods.name: maketree
methods.description: Generates the block hierarchy from template content.

methods.name: get_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets an error message.

methods.name: getfile
methods.description: Reads the content of a file.

methods.name: r_getfile
methods.description: Recursively processes {FILE "filename"} directives to include files.
